sources.snippet: understand transformers by ablation A gallery of controlled transformer experiments: remove or swap ONE thing, train it against a baseline, read the two curves. Each experiment is a self-contained folder built on nanoinfra.

sources.title: GitHub - FrenchKnuckles/ANLP_A1
sources.snippet: This repository contains a PyTorch implementation of a Seq2Seq Transformer trained to decrypt a substitution cipher. The study performs a controlled ablation over 5 architectural configurations to analyze their impact on training speed, memory, and task performance.

sources.title: abhirajratna/2024114011-anlp-a1 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: ANLP Assignment 1 — Custom Transformers & BLT From-scratch encoder-decoder Transformers trained to decrypt a repeating-key XOR cipher (binary string -> English plaintext), with a controlled five-configuration ablation over positional encoding, attention, normalisation and tokenization.
